scheme_name: Scheme for Financial Assistance to Integrated Logistics Facilities: Exemption of Electricity Duty
other_conditions: The subsidy is applicable only to new units or projects.
The developer must maintain and operate the logistic facilities for a minimum period of 5 years after commencement of operations.
benefits_summary: Exemption of Electricity Duty for the unit/project from the date of commencement of operation.
